description: Code-intelligence + deterministic code-map tools: turn source into an exact, greppable symbol graph WITHOUT an LLM guessing the structure. Two complementary families: (1) AST PARSERS that resolve structure from the syntax tree (codegraph / symbol_graph), and (2) the typed-IDENTIFIER CONVENTION (pyprefix) that encodes each definition's kind in its NAME so even grep is an exact resolver and a code map needs no resolver at all. The point the owner is after: generate deterministic graphs from prefixed class/method/function names + standardized object names, instead of an LLM doing non-deterministic graph building. A registry of technique + tool SPECS (what it does, deterministic?, when to use, what it composes with), pointers never truth. serves_truth=false.

tools.name: Typed greppable identifier convention (pyprefix standard)
tools.what: encode each definition's KIND in its name: class->py_class_<Pascal>, function->py_function_<snake>, method->py_method_<snake>, instance->py_inst_<snake>, constant->py_const_<UPPER>; dunders exempt; idempotent; underscores preserved
tools.when_to_use: adopt for NEW code (or per-package) so structural search + code maps become free; grep py_class_HTTPClient finds the class + every reference, grep '^def py_function_' lists all functions

tools.name: Conformance linter (deterministic, read-only)
tools.what: AST scan that reports every non-conforming definition with its location + the typed target name it should carry; exit 1 on violations
tools.when_to_use: CI gate to keep new code conformant; safe + read-only; lead with this before any rename on a multi-file tree

tools.name: Typed symbol map (def + references)
tools.what: a typed symbol index: every definition (kind + location) and the locations that reference its name; JSON or markdown
tools.when_to_use: feed a clean typed symbol stream to graph tools / refactor tools / the hybrid-graph + contradiction mappers; exact because the names are typed

tools.name: Exact symbol find (no resolver)
tools.what: locate every definition + reference of a symbol by its typed/greppable name across a tree
tools.when_to_use: find-all-uses without a language server; deterministic because the name says what it is

tools.name: Unified weighted code graph (AST)
tools.what: fuses file-import + symbol call/inherit graphs into one strength-ranked model; --audit ranks the strong connections (importers/callers by call-sites x confidence + blast radius) before/after a change
tools.when_to_use: the AST-based deterministic graph: structural questions (what calls what, what breaks) when names are NOT typed; confident-only resolution (no false hubs)

tools.name: AST symbol-level weighted graph
tools.what: function/class/method nodes + weighted edges (calls/inherits/contains) with module-aware confident-only resolution; weighted load-bearing ranking
tools.when_to_use: symbol-level structure + ranking from the AST; the parser-side complement to the convention

tools.name: Symbol-graph visualizer (html / mermaid / dot)
tools.what: render the typed symbol graph: nodes = definitions colored by kind, edges = contains/calls/uses; export self-contained interactive HTML, GitHub-inline Mermaid, or Graphviz DOT
tools.when_to_use: explore/share the structure visually; exact + offline because the names (or the AST) are deterministic, not LLM-inferred
